articles.title: Asian Stocks to Slide on Tech Rout, Bonds Rally: Markets Wrap - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: Technology stocks trimmed their losses heading into the European session, offering global investors some respite after renewed pressure on the artificial intelligence trade drove demand for bonds. Crude oil extended its gains.
